angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 751,356 km at 202.38 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 4.9411 +/- 0.0160 mas (same row, RUWE 0.97): 202.38 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.08 +/- 0.06 solar radii from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-35 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract): 751,356 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.05 +/- 0.19 solar masses from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-35 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5990 +/- 80 K from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-35 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-35 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/wasp-35.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.392, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, BD-06 1077: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-35 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.15 dex, from Stassun et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-35 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.1443, from Gaia DR2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...616A...1G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-35 (pscomppars): age 5 Gyr, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-35 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 3.9 km/s, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
